title: [CON-14] Space state is a linear signed chain in §3.3 but merged by union/LWW in §5.1.1
description: Review finding CON-14: Space state is a linear signed chain in §3.3 but merged by union/LWW in §5.1.1 (lens CON). Location: spec/03-spaces.md:49, :131, :157-159 (`/head` returns one CID); spec/05-messaging.md:24. Fix: Replace 05:24 with a fork rule: a deterministic winner (higher `seq`, then owner over admin, then lower CID). The losing branch's mutations are re-signed on top of the winner. An unsigned "union" cannot be valid state under 03:131 (S4). This follows from existing rules. Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
